digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) numbering and indexing system
propositions: ADR corpus contains 91 files with only 69 distinct numbers; 22 files share 17 collision numbers (five files numbered 0037, three each numbered 0007 and 0035, others doubled), creating ambiguous bare references.

Stale-base and in-flight Gerrit races cause collisions; pre-merge CI checks cannot prevent them because ADR 0047 permits post-rebase CI skipping, making per-number marker files in docs/adr/.numbers/ the race-free prevention mechanism.

Bare and slug-bearing ADR references in docs/ and src/ (AGENTS.md:42, CONTRIBUTING.md:173, gerrit-aws-setup.md:602) become stranded or ambiguous after collision resolution, requiring sweep-and-rewrite to maintain referential integrity.

Solution: renumber 22 duplicate-collision files to 0070-0091 (ascending landing-date order, earliest-landed keeps number); create marker files and generated index; assert bijection and referential integrity in CI check that fails on dangling cross-references or duplicate markers.
